observations: The page number «41» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «6» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L01-L04 end the correspondence of the tables begun on p. 40 (JP2 0072, L38-L40): the ditto marks „ stand under «Batt.», «Kh.» and «Tafel»; the bracketed remark after «3» runs on in two lines set under its beginning, L03-L04. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells of L03-L04 give the indentation and are not printed. L05 and L08: the headings of chapters 6 and 7, in bold, centred, each followed by the reference to the text.

L20-L26: the transliteration as printed: «al-ʿaḳd al-shamālī» (the northern node), «al-masīr al-wasaṭ», «al-wasaṭ», «al-masīr», «wasaṭ», with the ʿayn, the dots under ḳ and ṭ and the macrons; L34 «Raḳḳa» with dots under both k; L37 «Ibn ʿEzrā» spaced, with the ʿayn.

L31-L38: the radix of the sun, 113° 25′ 48″, as on p. 33 (JP2 0065, L19); al-Battānī's, 113° 58′ 4″, 32′ 16″ more. Checked: the difference of longitude between Ujjain and Raqqa, 75° 52′ less 39° 4′, 36° 48′, is a tenth of a day and about 6′ of the sun's mean motion, which leaves about 26′ between the two radices at the meridian of Raqqa, so that the radices do not agree, as the text says. The 9° 15′ at the beginning of the year 511 are to be compared with the tables of the mean motion of the sun.

N01: «Steinschneider» spaced, the colon after it after a thin space (14 px); a speck below the line between the c and the h of «Geschichte»; not transcribed. L38: «spricht1) ;», the semicolon after a thin space (12 px) after the note number.
The semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (11-15 px measured).

critical_notes.evidence: «die mittlere Bewegung», as in L19 and the heading of chapter 7 (L08); the n before the final g is printed as u, a turned n
